dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: How many times did Aralila lose? Did Aranishat win?

dialogues.speaker: Aralila
dialogues.text: So many matches. Who won? Who lost? Aralila doesn't know!

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: Huh? Forget it! Happy Festival Utsava, more important than winning.

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: Aranishat and Aralila both won, twice. All Aranara, and friends of Aranara, all won, for many times!
